# Monolith

```
 _____    _____________   __________     ___________________    ___
|     \  /             \ |          |   |                   |  |   |
|      \/       __      \|    __    |   |    ___     ___    |__|   |
|              |  |          |  |   |   |   |   |   |   |          |
|   |\    /|   |__|          |__|   |___|   |   |   |   |    __    |
|   | \__/ |          |\                    |   |   |   |   |  |   |
|___|      |__________| \___________________|   |___|   |___|  |___|
```

A data hoarder's dream come true: bundle any web page into a single HTML file. You can finally replace that gazillion of open tabs with a gazillion of .html files stored somewhere on your precious little drive.

Unlike the conventional "Save page as", `monolith` not only saves the target document, it embeds CSS, image, and JavaScript assets **all at once**, producing a single HTML5 document that is a joy to store and share.

If compared to saving websites with `wget -mpk`, this tool embeds all assets as data URLs and therefore lets browsers render the saved page exactly the way it was on the Internet, even when no network connection is available.

## Usage

```console
monolith https://lyrics.github.io/db/P/Portishead/Dummy/Roads/ -o %title%.%timestamp%.html
```

```console
cat some-site-page.html | monolith -aIiFfcMv -b https://some.site/ - > some-site-page-with-assets.html
```

## Options

 - `-a`: Exclude audio sources
 - `-b`: Use `custom base URL`
 - `-B`: Forbid retrieving assets from specified domain(s)
 - `-c`: Exclude CSS
 - `-C`: Read cookies from `file`
 - `-d`: Allow retrieving assets only from specified `domain(s)`
 - `-e`: Ignore network errors
 - `-E`: Save document using `custom encoding`
 - `-f`: Omit frames
 - `-F`: Exclude web fonts
 - `-h`: Print help information
 - `-i`: Remove images
 - `-I`: Isolate the document
 - `-j`: Exclude JavaScript
 - `-k`: Accept invalid X.509 (TLS) certificates
 - `-m`: Output in MHTML format instead of HTML
 - `-M`: Don't add timestamp and URL information
 - `-n`: Extract contents of NOSCRIPT elements
 - `-o`: Write output to `file` (use "-" for STDOUT)
 - `-q`: Be quiet
 - `-t`: Adjust `network request timeout`
 - `-u`: Provide `custom User-Agent`
 - `-v`: Exclude videos
 - `-V`: Print version number

## Whitelisting and blacklisting domains

Options `-d` and `-B` provide control over what domains can be used to retrieve assets from, e.g.:

```console
monolith -I -d example.com -d www.example.com https://example.com -o example-only.html
```

```console
monolith -I -B -d .googleusercontent.com -d googleanalytics.com -d .google.com https://example.com -o example-no-ads.html
```

## Dynamic content

Monolith doesn't feature a JavaScript engine, hence websites that retrieve and display data after initial load may require usage of additional tools.

For example, Chromium (Chrome) can be used to act as a pre-processor for such pages:

```console
chromium --headless --window-size=1920,1080 --run-all-compositor-stages-before-draw --virtual-time-budget=9000 --incognito --dump-dom https://github.com | monolith - -I -b https://github.com -o github.html
```

## Authentication

```console
monolith https://username:password@example.com -o example-basic-auth.html
```

## Proxies

Please set `https_proxy`, `http_proxy`, and `no_proxy` environment variables.
</output>

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Monolith - Bundle web pages into a single HTML file
"""

import sys
import os
import re
import base64
import mimetypes
import urllib.request
import urllib.parse
import urllib.error
import argparse
import datetime
import http.cookiejar
import ssl
from html.parser import HTMLParser

VERSION = "2.11.0"

# MIME type mapping based on file extension
MIME_TYPES = {
    'png': 'image/png',
    'jpg': 'image/jpeg',
    'jpeg': 'image/jpeg',
    'gif': 'image/gif',
    'svg': 'image/svg+xml',
    'webp': 'image/webp',
    'bmp': 'image/bmp',
    'ico': 'image/x-icon',
    'tiff': 'image/tiff',
    'tif': 'image/tiff',
    'mp3': 'audio/mpeg',
    'ogg': 'audio/ogg',
    'oga': 'audio/ogg',
    'wav': 'audio/wav',
    'mp4': 'video/mp4',
    'woff': 'font/woff',
    'woff2': 'font/woff2',
    'css': 'text/css',
    'js': 'application/javascript',
    'json': 'application/json',
    'xml': 'text/xml',
    'html': 'text/html',
    'htm': 'text/html',
}

def get_mime_type(url):
    """Get MIME type from URL/file extension."""
    ext = url.rsplit('.', 1)[-1].lower().split('#')[0].split('?')[0]
    return MIME_TYPES.get(ext, '')


# Void elements (no closing tag in HTML5)
VOID_ELEMENTS = {
    'area', 'base', 'br', 'col', 'embed', 'hr', 'img', 'input',
    'link', 'meta', 'param', 'source', 'track', 'wbr'
}

# Raw text elements (content not parsed for entities)
RAW_TEXT_ELEMENTS = {'script', 'style'}

# Escapable raw text elements
ESCAPABLE_RAW_TEXT = {'textarea', 'title'}


class Node:
    """Represents an HTML DOM node."""
    def __init__(self, node_type, **kwargs):
        self.type = node_type  # 'document', 'doctype', 'element', 'text', 'comment'
        self.kwargs = kwargs
        
    @classmethod
    def document(cls):
        n = cls('document')
        n.children = []
        return n
    
    @classmethod
    def doctype(cls, name='html', public='', system=''):
        n = cls('doctype')
        n.name = name
        n.public = public
        n.system = system
        return n
    
    @classmethod
    def element(cls, tag, attrs=None):
        n = cls('element')
        n.tag = tag.lower()
        n.attrs = attrs or {}  # dict of attr_name -> attr_value
        n.attrs_order = list(attrs.keys()) if attrs else []
        n.children = []
        return n
    
    @classmethod
    def text(cls, data):
        n = cls('text')
        n.data = data
        return n
    
    @classmethod
    def comment(cls, data):
        n = cls('comment')
        n.data = data
        return n


class HTMLTreeBuilder(HTMLParser):
    """Build a DOM tree from HTML."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=False)
        self.root = Node.document()
        self.stack = [self.root]
        self.doctype = None
        self._current_raw = None
        self._raw_data = ''
        
    def handle_decl(self, decl):
        # DOCTYPE
        node = Node.doctype()
        node.name = 'html'
        self.root.children.append(node)
    
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        tag = tag.lower()
        
        # Handle raw text elements
        if tag in RAW_TEXT_ELEMENTS:
            self._current_raw = tag
        
        # Build ordered attrs dict
        attrs_dict = {}
        attrs_order = []
        for name, value in attrs:
            name = name.lower()
            if value is None:
                value = ''
            attrs_dict[name] = value
            attrs_order.append(name)
        
        node = Node.element(tag, attrs_dict)
        node.attrs_order = attrs_order
        self.stack[-1].children.append(node)
        
        if tag not in VOID_ELEMENTS:
            self.stack.append(node)
    
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        tag = tag.lower()
        if tag in RAW_TEXT_ELEMENTS and self._current_raw == tag:
            # Add raw text as child
            if self._raw_data:
                self.stack[-1].children.append(Node.text(self._raw_data))
                self._raw_data = ''
            self._current_raw = None
        
        # Pop the stack back to this tag
        for i in range(len(self.stack) - 1, 0, -1):
            if self.stack[i].type == 'element' and self.stack[i].tag == tag:
                self.stack = self.stack[:i]
                return
    
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self._current_raw:
            self._raw_data += data
        else:
            self.stack[-1].children.append(Node.text(data))
    
    def handle_entityref(self, name):
        """Handle named character references like &"""
        if self._current_raw:
            self._raw_data += f'&{name};'
        else:
            self.stack[-1].children.append(Node.text(f'&{name};'))
    
    def handle_charref(self, name):
        """Handle numeric character references like '"""
        if name.startswith('x') or name.startswith('X'):
            char = chr(int(name[1:], 16))
        else:
            char = chr(int(name))
        if self._current_raw:
            self._raw_data += char
        else:
            self.stack[-1].children.append(Node.text(char))
    
    def handle_comment(self, data):
        self.stack[-1].children.append(Node.comment(data))
    
    def unknown_decl(self, data):
        pass


def parse_html(content):
    """Parse HTML string and return DOM tree."""
    builder = HTMLTreeBuilder()
    builder.feed(content)

    def unknown_decl(self, data):
        pass


def parse_html(content):
    """Parse HTML string and return DOM tree."""
    builder = HTMLTreeBuilder()
    builder.feed(content)
    return builder.root


def escape_text(text):
    """Escape text for HTML text nodes."""
    text = text.replace('&', '&')
    text = text.replace('<', '<')
    text = text.replace('>', '>')
    return text


def escape_attr(value):
    """Escape attribute value for double-quoted HTML attributes."""
    value = value.replace('&', '&')
    value = value.replace('"', '"')
    return value


def serialize_node(node, result=None):
    """Serialize a DOM node to HTML string."""
    if result is None:
        result = []
    
    if node.type == 'document':
        for child in node.children:
            serialize_node(child, result)
    
    elif node.type == 'doctype':
        result.append('<!DOCTYPE html>')
    
    elif node.type == 'text':
        result.append(escape_text(node.data))
    
    elif node.type == 'comment':
        result.append(f'<!--{node.data}-->')
    
    elif node.type == 'element':
        tag = node.tag
        
        # Start tag
        result.append(f'<{tag}')
        for attr_name in node.attrs_order:
            attr_val = node.attrs[attr_name]
            result.append(f' {attr_name}="{escape_attr(attr_val)}"')
        result.append('>')
        
        # Children
        for child in node.children:
            serialize_node(child, result)
        
        # End tag (not for void elements, but for inserted meta/etc)
        if tag not in VOID_ELEMENTS or node.attrs.get('_inserted'):
            result.append(f'</{tag}>')
    
    return ''.join(result)

def find_target_document(url_or_path, opts):
    """
    Determine the target URL and fetch the document.
    Returns (content, base_url, is_stdin) or raises SystemExit.
    """
    target = url_or_path
    
    if target == '-':
        # Read from stdin
        content = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        base_url = opts.base_url or 'http://example.com/'
        return content, base_url, True
    
    # Check if it's a URL
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(target)
    
    if parsed.scheme in ('http', 'https'):
        # HTTP URL
        base_url = target
        fetcher = Fetcher(opts)
        result = fetcher.fetch(target)
        if result is None:
            print(f"Error: could not retrieve target document", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        content, _ = result
        return content, base_url, False
    
    elif parsed.scheme == 'file':
        # file:// URL
        base_url = target
        path = urllib.request.url2pathname(parsed.path)
        if not opts.quiet:
            print(target, file=sys.stderr)
        if not os.path.isfile(path):
            if not opts.quiet:
                print(f"{target} (file not found)", file=sys.stderr)
            print("Error: could not retrieve target document", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        with open(path, 'rb') as f:
            content = f.read()
        return content, base_url, False
    
    elif not parsed.scheme or parsed.scheme in ('', '/'):
        # Local file path
        if os.path.isabs(target) or target.startswith('./') or target.startswith('../'):
            # Absolute or relative path
            abs_path = os.path.abspath(target)
            base_url = 'file://' + abs_path
            if not opts.quiet:
                print(base_url, file=sys.stderr)
            if not os.path.isfile(abs_path):
                if not opts.quiet:
                    print(f"{base_url} (file not found)", file=sys.stderr)
                print("Error: could not retrieve target document", file=sys.stderr)
                sys.exit(1)
            with open(abs_path, 'rb') as f:
                content = f.read()
            return content, base_url, False
        else:
            # Could be a relative path or an HTTP URL without scheme
            # Try as file first
            abs_path = os.path.abspath(target)
            if os.path.isfile(abs_path):
                base_url = 'file://' + abs_path
                if not opts.quiet:

                with open(abs_path, 'rb') as f:

                return content, base_url, False
            else:
                # Try as HTTP URL

                return content, http_url, False
    else:

        if not opts.quiet:
            print(f"http://{target}", file=sys.stderr)
        print("Error: could not retrieve target document", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    parser.add_argument('-j', '--no-js', action='store_true',

    parser.add_argument('-k', '--insecure', action='store_true',

    parser.add_argument('-m', '--mhtml', action='store_true',

    parser.add_argument('-M', '--no-metadata', action='store_true',

    parser.add_argument('-n', '--unwrap-noscript', action='store_true',

    parser.add_argument('-o', '--output', metavar='result.html',

    parser.add_argument('-q', '--quiet', action='store_true',

    parser.add_argument('-t', '--timeout', metavar='60', type=int, default=60,

    html_str = content.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')

    doc_base_url = process_document(document, base_url, opts, fetcher)
    
    # Apply no-js transformations
    if opts.no_js:

    # Handle noscript unwrapping
    if opts.unwrap_noscript:
        handle_noscript_unwrap(document)
    
    # Add/update robots meta
    head = find_head(document)
    add_robots_meta(head)
    
    # Add CSP meta if needed
    csp = build_csp(opts)
    if csp:
        add_csp_meta(head, csp)
    
    # Add encoding meta if specified
    if opts.encoding:
        add_encoding_meta(head, opts.encoding)
    
    # Serialize to HTML
    html_output = serialize_document(document)
    
    # Add metadata comment if not -M
    if not opts.no_metadata:
        timestamp = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
        source = 'local source' if base_url.startswith('file://') else base_url
        metadata_comment = f'<!-- Saved from {source} at {timestamp} using monolith v{VERSION} -->\n'
        html_output = metadata_comment + html_output
    
    # Handle MHTML format
    if opts.mhtml:
        html_output = create_mhtml(html_output, doc_base_url)
    
    # Write output
    output_bytes = html_output.encode('utf-8')
    
    if opts.output and opts.output != '-':
        with open(opts.output, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(output_bytes)
    else:
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(output_bytes)
        if not opts.output:
            sys.stdout.buffer.flush()


def create_mhtml(html_content, base_url):
    """Create MHTML format output."""
    boundary = '----=_NextPart_000_0000'
    
    output = []
    output.append('MIME-Version: 1.0')
    output.append(f'Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary="{boundary}"')
    output.append('')
    output.append(f'------=_NextPart_000_0000')
    output.append('Content-Type: text/html; charset="utf-8"')
    output.append(f'Content-Location: {base_url}')
    output.append('')
    output.append(html_content)
    output.append(f'------=_NextPart_000_0000--')
    
    return '\n'.join(output)

    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(target)
    
    if parsed.scheme in ('http', 'https'):
        # HTTP URL
        base_url = target
        fetcher = Fetcher(opts)
        result = fetcher.fetch(target)
        if result is None:
            print(f"Error: could not retrieve target document", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        content, _ = result
        return content, base_url, False
    
    elif parsed.scheme == 'file':
        # file:// URL
        base_url = target
        path = urllib.request.url2pathname(parsed.path)
        if not opts.quiet:
            print(target, file=sys.stderr)
        if not os.path.isfile(path):
            if not opts.quiet:
                print(f"{target} (file not found)", file=sys.stderr)
            print("Error: could not retrieve target document", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        with open(path, 'rb') as f:
            content = f.read()
        return content, base_url, False
    
    elif not parsed.scheme or parsed.scheme in ('', '/'):
        # Local file path
        if os.path.isabs(target) or target.startswith('./') or target.startswith('../'):
            # Absolute or relative path
            abs_path = os.path.abspath(target)
            base_url = 'file://' + abs_path
            if not opts.quiet:
                print(base_url, file=sys.stderr)
            if not os.path.isfile(abs_path):
                if not opts.quiet:
                    print(f"{base_url} (file not found)", file=sys.stderr)
                print("Error: could not retrieve target document", file=sys.stderr)
                sys.exit(1)
            with open(abs_path, 'rb') as f:
                content = f.read()
            return content, base_url, False
        else:
            # Could be a relative path or an HTTP URL without scheme
            # Try as file first
            abs_path = os.path.abspath(target)
            if os.path.isfile(abs_path):
                base_url = 'file://' + abs_path
                if not opts.quiet:
                    print(base_url, file=sys.stderr)
                with open(abs_path, 'rb') as f:
                    content = f.read()
                return content, base_url, False
            else:
                # Try as HTTP URL
                http_url = 'http://' + target
                if not opts.quiet:
                    print(http_url, file=sys.stderr)
                parsed2 = urllib.parse.urlparse(http_url)
                fetcher = Fetcher(opts)
                result = fetcher.fetch(http_url)
                if result is None:
                    print("Error: could not retrieve target document", file=sys.stderr)
                    sys.exit(1)
                content, _ = result
                return content, http_url, False
    else:
        # Unknown scheme - try as HTTP
        if not opts.quiet:
            print(f"http://{target}", file=sys.stderr)
        print("Error: could not retrieve target document", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog='monolith',
        description='CLI tool and library for saving web pages as a single HTML file',
        add_help=False
    )
    
    parser.add_argument('target', metavar='TARGET',
                        help='URL or file path, use - for STDIN')
    parser.add_argument('-a', '--no-audio', action='store_true',
                        help='Remove audio sources')
    parser.add_argument('-b', '--base-url', metavar='http://localhost/',
                        help='Set custom base URL')
    parser.add_argument('-B', '--blacklist-domains', action='store_true',
                        help='Treat specified domains as blacklist')
    parser.add_argument('-c', '--no-css', action='store_true',
                        help='Remove CSS')
    parser.add_argument('-C', '--cookie-file', metavar='cookies.txt',
                        help='Specify cookie file')
    parser.add_argument('-d', '--domain', metavar='example.com', action='append',
                        help='Specify domains to use for white/black-listing')
    parser.add_argument('-e', '--ignore-errors', action='store_true',
                        help='Ignore network errors')
    parser.add_argument('-E', '--encoding', metavar='UTF-8',
                        help='Enforce custom charset')
    parser.add_argument('-f', '--no-frames', action='store_true',
                        help='Remove frames and iframes')
    parser.add_argument('-F', '--no-fonts', action='store_true',
                        help='Remove fonts')
    parser.add_argument('-i', '--no-images', action='store_true',
                        help='Remove images')
    parser.add_argument('-I', '--isolate', action='store_true',
                        help='Cut off document from the Internet')
    parser.add_argument('-j', '--no-js', action='store_true',
                        help='Remove JavaScript')
    parser.add_argument('-k', '--insecure', action='store_true',
                        help='Allow invalid X.509 (TLS) certificates')
    parser.add_argument('-m', '--mhtml', action='store_true',
                        help='Use MHTML as output format')
    parser.add_argument('-M', '--no-metadata', action='store_true',
                        help='Exclude timestamp and source information')
    parser.add_argument('-n', '--unwrap-noscript', action='store_true',
                        help='Replace NOSCRIPT elements with their contents')
    parser.add_argument('-o', '--output', metavar='result.html',
                        help='File to write to, use - for STDOUT')
    parser.add_argument('-q', '--quiet', action='store_true',
                        help='Suppress verbosity')
    parser.add_argument('-t', '--timeout', metavar='60', type=int, default=60,
                        help='Adjust network request timeout')
    parser.add_argument('-u', '--user-agent', metavar='Firefox',
                        help='Set custom User-Agent string')
    parser.add_argument('-v', '--no-video', action='store_true',
                        help='Remove video sources')
    parser.add_argument('-h', '--help', action='store_true',
                        help='Print help')
    parser.add_argument('-V', '--version', action='store_true',
                        help='Print version')
    
    opts = parser.parse_args()
    
    # Handle special flags
    if opts.version:
        print(f'monolith {VERSION}')
        sys.exit(0)
    
    if opts.help:
        print_help()
        sys.exit(0)
    
    # Fetch the target document
    fetcher = Fetcher(opts)
    
    content, base_url, is_stdin = find_target_document(opts.target, opts)
    
    # Detect encoding
    html_str = content.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    
    # Parse HTML
    document = parse_html(html_str)
    
    # Find head (create if needed)
    head = find_head(document)
    
    # Process the document
    doc_base_url = process_document(document, base_url, opts, fetcher)
    
    # Apply no-js transformations
    if opts.no_js:
        apply_no_js_recursively(document)
    
    # Handle noscript unwrapping
    if opts.unwrap_noscript:
        handle_noscript_unwrap(document)
    
    # Add/update robots meta
    head = find_head(document)
    add_robots_meta(head)
    
    # Add CSP meta if needed
    csp = build_csp(opts)
    if csp:
        add_csp_meta(head, csp)
    
    # Add encoding meta if specified
    if opts.encoding:
        add_encoding_meta(head, opts.encoding)
    
    # Serialize to HTML
    html_output = serialize_document(document)
    
    # Add metadata comment if not -M
    if not opts.no_metadata:
        timestamp = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
        source = 'local source' if base_url.startswith('file://') else base_url
        metadata_comment = f'<!-- Saved from {source} at {timestamp} using monolith v{VERSION} -->\n'
        html_output = metadata_comment + html_output
    
    # Handle MHTML format
    if opts.mhtml:
        html_output = create_mhtml(html_output, doc_base_url)
    
    # Write output
    output_bytes = html_output.encode('utf-8')
    
    if opts.output and opts.output != '-':
        with open(opts.output, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(output_bytes)
    else:
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(output_bytes)
        if not opts.output:
            sys.stdout.buffer.flush()


def create_mhtml(html_content, base_url):
    """Create MHTML format output."""
    boundary = '----=_NextPart_000_0000'
    
    output = []
    output.append('MIME-Version: 1.0')
    output.append(f'Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary="{boundary}"')
    output.append('')
    output.append(f'------=_NextPart_000_0000')
    output.append('Content-Type: text/html; charset="utf-8"')
    output.append(f'Content-Location: {base_url}')
    output.append('')
    output.append(html_content)
    output.append(f'------=_NextPart_000_0000--')
    
    return '\n'.join(output)

# 2. File URL not found -> remove src (current behavior)

python3 << 'EOF'
with open('/workspace/monolith.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find and update the _emb function to return resolved URL on HTTP failure
# The current _emb function:
# def _emb(url,base,fetcher):
#     if not url or url.startswith('data:'): return url,True
#     au=resolve(base,url)
#     r=fetcher.fetch(au)
#     if r is None: return None,False
#     ...

# New behavior: if the resolved URL is HTTP/HTTPS and fetch fails, return (resolved_url, True)

old = """def _emb(url,base,fetcher):
    if not url or url.startswith('data:'): return url,True
    au=resolve(base,url)
    r=fetcher.fetch(au)
    if r is None: return None,False
    cont,m=r
    if not m: m=mime(au)
    frag=('#'+url.split('#',1)[1]) if '#' in url else ''
    enc=base64.b64encode(cont).decode('ascii')
    return (f'data:{m};base64,{enc}{frag}' if m else f'data:;base64,{enc}{frag}'),True"""

    if not url or url.startswith('data:'): return url,True
    au=resolve(base,url)

        # For HTTP/HTTPS URLs, keep the resolved URL; for file://, remove
        p=urllib.parse.urlparse(au)
        if p.scheme in ('http','https'): return au,True
        return None,False
    cont,m=r
    if not m: m=mime(au)
    frag=('#'+url.split('#',1)[1]) if '#' in url else ''
    enc=base64.b64encode(cont).decode('ascii')
    return (f'data:{m};base64,{enc}{frag}' if m else f'data:;base64,{enc}{frag}'),True"""

content = content.replace(old, new)

with open('/workspace/monolith.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

import ast
try:
    ast.parse(content)
    print('OK')
except SyntaxError as e:
    print(f'Error: {e}')
EOF

## Summary

I've implemented **monolith v2.11.0** - a web page bundler that saves web pages as a single HTML file - in Python using only the standard library.

### Key implementation details:

1. **HTML Parsing** (`monolith.py`): Uses Python's built-in `html.parser` to build a DOM tree and serialize back to HTML

2. **Resource Embedding**: 
   - Images → base64 data URLs
   - CSS stylesheets → base64 data URLs
   - JavaScript → inlined as text
   - Fonts → base64 data URLs
   - Audio/Video → base64 data URLs
   - iframes → base64 HTML data URLs (processed recursively)

3. **CSS Processing**: Handles `url()` references, `@import`, CSS string quote normalization (single → double quotes)

4. **Flags**: All original flags supported: `-a`, `-b`, `-B`, `-c`, `-C`, `-d`, `-e`, `-E`, `-f`, `-F`, `-i`, `-I`, `-j`, `-k`, `-m`, `-M`, `-n`, `-o`, `-q`, `-t`, `-u`, `-v`, `-h`, `-V`

5. **CSP Headers**: Added when using isolation/restriction flags

6. **MHTML Format**: Proper multipart MIME output with CRLF headers, implies no-JS mode

7. **Robots Meta**: Always added/updated to `content="none"`

8. **Error Handling**: HTTP URLs kept on fetch failure, file URLs removed
